response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned software engineer with strong architectural and mentoring skills, particularly in web technologies, DLang, and test-driven development. However, he falls significantly short of the minimum requirement of 8 years of C++ programming, possessing less than a year of professional C++ experience from nearly a decade ago. Furthermore, his background leans heavily toward full-stack web and application development rather than the deep, large-scale cloud compute and hardware architecture required for this specific platform leadership role.
strengths: Proven track record in software design, architecture, and establishing engineering best practices like TDD and CI/CD.
Demonstrated passion for mentoring and knowledge sharing through organizing coding Dojos, workshops, and courses.
Experience building high-throughput microservices and distributed data platforms, such as handling millions of HTTP requests at Dunnhumby.
concerns: Fails to meet the critical minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ programming experience, showing only ~7 months of professional exposure.
Infrastructure experience is predominantly web-centric (Node.js, TypeScript, DLang) rather than focused on low-level compute technologies or hardware architecture.
Lacks recent, dedicated experience as a Technical Lead managing priorities specifically for cloud compute or DevOps engineering teams.
